📍 Job Overview
Job Title: Data Center Deputy Design Manager
Company: AECOM
Location: Bucharest, Romania
Job Type: Full-time
Category: Engineering & Design Management (Data Centers)
Date Posted: November 5, 2026
Experience Level: 10+ Years
Remote Status: Hybrid
🚀 Role Summary
Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary design teams for complex Data Center projects within AECOM's Enterprise Capabilities (EC) portfolio, ensuring technical excellence and adherence to global standards.
Manage the full design lifecycle, from conceptualization through to detailed design, focusing on critical infrastructure and mission-critical facilities.
Drive stakeholder influence and clear communication, operating with a high degree of autonomy and accountability to challenge assumptions and ensure project success.
Support the Design Manager in resource planning, workload forecasting, and the continuous improvement of design processes and governance.
Ensure all design deliverables meet AECOM's stringent PDS, QA/QC, and specific Data Center design standards, with a keen eye on constructability and risk mitigation.
📝 Enhancement Note: This role is positioned as a senior-level Deputy Design Manager within AECOM's Enterprise Capabilities team, which acts as a global workshare and technical expertise hub. The emphasis on "Think and Act Globally" and "digital adoption" suggests a dynamic, cross-border operational environment. The role requires a blend of technical engineering acumen and strong project/design management capabilities, with a clear expectation of leadership maturity and proactive problem-solving in the high-stakes data center sector.
📈 Primary Responsibilities
Support the Design Manager in overseeing the complete design lifecycle for multiple complex Data Center projects, ensuring integrated and efficient delivery.
Coordinate and guide multidisciplinary design teams, including Architecture, MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing), Structural, Civil, Fire Protection, and Security specialists, to achieve cohesive design outcomes.
Guarantee that all design deliverables strictly adhere to AECOM's Project Delivery System (PDS), Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) protocols, and established Data Center design standards.
Conduct thorough reviews of design packages to verify technical accuracy, completeness, constructability, and compliance with project requirements and industry best practices.
Proactively identify potential design risks, technical gaps, and interdependencies across disciplines, developing and implementing effective mitigation strategies.
Manage multiple concurrent design workstreams, ensuring seamless alignment with overall project schedules and client objectives.
Collaborate closely with other Design Managers and technical leads to foster integrated project delivery and optimize resource utilization across regional and global teams.
Support resource planning, accurate workload forecasting, and effective coordination with distributed teams to meet project demands.
Diligently track design progress, monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), and escalate any emerging issues or roadblocks to senior management promptly.
Operate with a high level of professional maturity (JL8–JL9 maturity), demonstrating the ability to articulate technical viewpoints, challenge existing assumptions constructively, and drive accountability for design outcomes.
Maintain transparent and effective communication channels with internal project teams, technical leads, and external client stakeholders.
Actively participate in and support design reviews, coordination meetings, and progress reporting sessions to ensure all parties are informed and aligned.
Contribute to the ongoing refinement and continuous improvement of AECOM's design processes, standards, and governance frameworks within the Enterprise Capabilities team.
Assist the Design Manager in preparing comprehensive design presentations, responding to technical clarifications, and delivering regular progress updates to clients and internal stakeholders.
Foster and maintain regular, constructive communication with client-side design representatives to ensure alignment and address their needs.
Identify emerging design-related risks, potential opportunities, and key trends within the broader Data Center program to inform strategic decision-making.
📝 Enhancement Note: The responsibilities highlight a strong emphasis on process adherence (PDS, QA/QC), risk management, and cross-functional team leadership. The mention of "JL8–JL9 maturity" indicates an expectation of senior-level independent contribution and influence. The role is clearly geared towards managing the delivery of design rather than pure conceptual design, with a focus on coordination, review, and adherence to standards.
🎓 Skills & Qualifications
Education:
Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering is required.
Experience:
A minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in engineering and design management is essential.
Demonstrable experience in managing the design process for Data Centers or other mission-critical facilities is highly preferred.
Proven track record of successfully coordinating multidisciplinary design teams on complex projects.
Required Skills:
Data Center Design Principles: In-depth understanding of the unique requirements and challenges of data center infrastructure design, including power, cooling, structural, and IT infrastructure considerations.
Design Management: Proficiency in managing the end-to-end design process, including scope definition, scheduling, resource allocation, and quality control.
Multidisciplinary Coordination: Expertise in coordinating diverse engineering and architectural disciplines to ensure integrated and optimized design solutions.
Project Management Fundamentals: Solid understanding of project management principles, including schedule tracking, risk identification, and issue resolution.
Technical Review & QA/QC: Ability to meticulously review design documents for technical accuracy, completeness, constructability, and compliance with standards.
Stakeholder Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage effectively with internal teams and external clients.
Problem-Solving & Risk Mitigation: Strong analytical skills to identify potential issues and develop robust mitigation strategies.
English Fluency: Fluent command of the English language, both written and spoken, is mandatory for effective communication within AECOM's global teams and with clients.
Preferred Skills:

Structural & Civil Design Coordination: Familiarity with structural and civil engineering considerations critical for data center facilities.
Fire Protection & Security Systems: Understanding of specialized design requirements for fire suppression and security systems in critical environments.

📍 Job Overview
Job Title: Fabricator (Prototyping)
Company: Runware
Location: Bucharest, Romania
Job Type: Full-time
Category: Operations (Prototyping & Manufacturing Operations)
Date Posted: November 04, 2026
Experience Level: Mid-Level (3+ years)
Remote Status: On-site
🚀 Role Summary
This role is pivotal in transforming advanced engineering designs into tangible, working hardware prototypes, requiring a deep understanding of manufacturing processes and precision assembly.
The Fabricator will operate sophisticated machinery, including CNC mills, lathes, and automated welding cells, to produce components for next-generation AI infrastructure and modular data centers.
Key focus areas include owning the fabrication quality from raw materials to finished product, providing critical feedback on manufacturability, and contributing to fast build-test-iterate cycles.
This position demands a hands-on approach, blending technical fabrication skills with the ability to interpret complex engineering drawings and GD&T, ensuring prototypes meet stringent performance and tolerance requirements.
📝 Enhancement Note: While the job title is "Fabricator," the responsibilities and requirements clearly position this role within a specialized manufacturing operations or R&D prototyping function, emphasizing precision, engineering collaboration, and direct impact on product development cycles. The "hands-on" nature, "owning the engineering," and "feedback on manufacturability" are strong indicators of an operations role focused on bringing designs to life and optimizing production feasibility.
📈 Primary Responsibilities
Machine Operation & Programming: Set up, program, and operate CNC mills, lathes, and other numerically controlled equipment using 2D drawings and 3D CAD models, ensuring adherence to G-code and CAM programming standards.
Automated Welding: Program, set up, and operate automated and robotic welding cells (MIG/TIG), including the design and implementation of necessary fixtures and fine-tuning of welding parameters for various materials.
Prototype & Test Rig Assembly: Precisely assemble mechanical and electromechanical prototypes, sub-assemblies, and test rigs according to detailed engineering specifications and drawings.
Technical Drawing Interpretation: Read and interpret complex engineering drawings, including Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) callouts, weld symbols, and Bills of Materials (BOMs), ensuring accurate fabrication and assembly.
Quality Inspection & Documentation: Perform meticulous inspections of fabricated parts using precision metrology tools such as calipers, micrometers, and height gauges, and accurately document inspection results.
Tooling & Fixture Development: Design and build specialized jigs, fixtures, and tooling to enhance efficiency and speed for repetitive fabrication tasks.
Manufacturability Feedback: Provide early and constructive feedback to mechanical and systems engineers regarding manufacturability, optimal tolerances, material selection, and cost-effectiveness of designs.
Workshop Management: Maintain and service machinery and tools, ensure the workshop is safe, clean, and organized, track material usage, manage stock and consumables, and oversee supplier orders.
Health & Safety Compliance: Strictly adhere to all health, safety, and environmental regulations related to machining, welding, and pressure work, particularly concerning specific Romanian and EU standards.
📝 Enhancement Note: The responsibilities highlight a blend of advanced manufacturing execution and direct engineering input. The emphasis on "owning fabrication quality," "giving engineers early feedback on manufacturability," and "fast build-test-iterate cycles" points to a crucial role in the product development lifecycle, typical of operations professionals in R&D or advanced manufacturing settings.
🎓 Skills & Qualifications

Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in fabrication, machining, or a prototype workshop environment.
Required Skills:
Numerical Control (NC) Fabrication: Proven experience with CNC machining, including programming (G-code) and CAM software (e.g., Fusion 360, Mastercam, SolidCAM).
Automated & Manual Welding: Experience setting up and operating automated or robotic welding systems, coupled with strong manual MIG/TIG welding skills on steel, stainless steel, and aluminum.
Prototype Assembly: Demonstrated ability to assemble prototypes from technical drawings, including precise mechanical fit-up, fastening techniques, and basic electrical wiring.
Technical Drawing Comprehension: Proficiency in reading and interpreting engineering drawings, GD&T, and weld symbols, with a capacity to work to tight tolerances.
Precision Measurement: Confident and accurate use of precision measuring tools for quality control and inspection.
Quality Documentation: Ability to produce clear and concise quality documentation for fabricated parts and processes.
Language Proficiency: Fluent in both Romanian and English, essential for understanding technical documentation and collaborating with international teams.
Preferred Skills:
High-Pressure Systems Fabrication: Experience fabricating components for high-pressure systems (piping, manifolds, vessels, fittings) and performing associated leak and pressure testing.
Refrigeration/HVAC-R Component Experience: Familiarity with refrigeration or HVAC-R components, including copper and stainless tubing, brazing, flaring, swaging, and heat exchanger fabrication.
Regulatory Compliance: Knowledge of pressure equipment standards (e.g., PED 2014/68/EU, ASME) and Romanian ISCIR requirements.
Certifications: Welder certification (ISO 9606 or equivalent) and refrigerant handling (F-gas) certification.
CAD Skills: Ability to use CAD software (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or similar) for minor part adjustments and fixture design.
